models.mechanism: The incursion model gains its missing endpoint: the panting rush does not merely cross a boundary, strike, raid at dawn, and raise dust; it penetrates into the center of a gathered body. The focus ayah now reads as the opening pressure of a raid whose function is not peripheral harassment but central insertion into an assembled group.

structural_cues: 100:5 continues the same فـ chain and repeats به, linking central entry to the already raised dust or raid-motion.
The sequence now has a full spatial arc: approach, strike, dawn charge, dust-cloud, entry into the middle.
The new finite verb وسطن gives the agents a completed positional result, not just an effect on the environment.
ج م ع/B002 supplies the collective object that the earlier enemy branch ع د و/B003 lacked.

abductive_moves.assumption: The gathered body in 100:5 is the opposed target of the raid rather than the raiders' own formation.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies entry into a gathering but does not explicitly label that gathering as enemy or target.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: panting runners, dawn raiders, dust raised, then entry into a gathered body; inferred arrow: the initial boundary-crossing rush culminates in penetration of an opposed collective center.
alternatives: جمعا could be the raiders as a collective rather than the group they enter.
The middle could be a neutral spatial position rather than tactical penetration.

changed_reading.before: At stage 3, the focus began a dawn incursion that disturbed the ground and raised dust.
changed_reading.after: After 100:5, the focus begins a raid with a precise endpoint: the panting force drives through dust into the center of an assembled body.

models.ablation: Removing 100:5 و س ط/B003 or ج م ع/B002 leaves the stage-3 raid as disturbance without a central target. Removing ع د و/B001 leaves a vivid central entry scene but loses the focus-root activation of boundary-crossing aggression.

models.mechanism: The exertion model is revised from transmitted turbulence into concentrated arrival. Panting marks force being gathered in bodies; sparks and dust show that force passing into the ground and air; 100:5 now shows the force gathered spatially into the middle of a collective. The focus is not only expenditure but directed concentration.

structural_cues: The repeated فـ sequence now moves from exertion through impact and dust to centered arrival.
100:5 repeats به after 100:4, making the dust-raising and central entry feel like consecutive results of the same exerted force.
ج م ع/B010 directly activates a horse-motion branch: force or running gathers until concentrated.
و س ط/B003 changes the endpoint from time-at-dawn to position-in-the-middle.

abductive_moves.assumption: The panting in 100:1 is the bodily sign of force later gathered into central penetration.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies panting and central entry, but not a physical theory of concentration from breath to center.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: running with breath, impact, dust, entry into the middle of a gathering; inferred arrow: exerted motion accumulates and focuses until it reaches a central position.
alternatives: The central entry could be tactically significant without revising the bodily expenditure model.
ج م ع/B010 may remain a general branch of gathering force rather than a direct bridge to the focus runners.

changed_reading.before: At stage 3, the focus read as bodily pressure becoming environmental turbulence.
changed_reading.after: After 100:5, the focus reads as bodily pressure gathered and aimed: panting motion concentrates into entry at the middle of a collected body.

models.ablation: Removing 100:5 ج م ع/B010 leaves exertion and central entry but weakens the idea of force being gathered. Removing و س ط/B003 removes the concentrated endpoint. Removing ض ب ح/B001 leaves the spatial result but not the focus-specific pressure that begins it.

models.mechanism: The material upheaval model is revised into a medium of penetration. Dust is no longer only an external trace of impact; because 100:5 repeats به and then enters the middle of a gathering, the raised dust can function as the medium or cover through which the panting force reaches the center. The focus breath starts an atmospheric chain: breath, spark, dust, obscured central entry.

structural_cues: 100:4 and 100:5 use parallel finite verbs with به, making dust-raising and central entry a linked pair.
The sequence of effects now gives atmosphere plus location: dust rises, then the agents enter the middle by it or in that condition.
The gathered body gives the airborne dust a tactical or spatial function, not merely a visual one.
This revises the stage-3 material model without replacing its fire and dust traces.

abductive_moves.assumption: The pronoun به in 100:5 lets the raised dust or the preceding disturbance function as the medium enabling entry.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies the repeated pronoun and sequence, but the exact antecedent and enabling relation are not explicit.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: dust raised thereby, then entry into the middle thereby; inferred arrow: the disturbed dusty atmosphere accompanies or enables penetration into the gathering.
alternatives: به in 100:5 could refer to the raid-time, the running, or the place rather than the dust-cloud.
Central entry may simply happen after dust rises, not because of it.

changed_reading.before: At stage 3, the focus began a material upheaval in which breath and impact released sparks and dust.
changed_reading.after: After 100:5, the focus begins an atmospheric penetration: panting and impact raise a dust-cloud through which the agents enter the center of an assembled body.

models.ablation: Removing 100:5 removes the tactical or mediating function of dust, leaving only the stage-3 material upheaval. Removing 100:4 ن ق ع/B004 leaves central entry but no dust medium. Removing ض ب ح/B003 weakens the focus-root bridge from panting to impact-generated particulate trace.

models.mechanism: A new ambiguous reading appears because the same central-entry root can also mean justice, choice, and moderation. The panting incursion may therefore be framed ironically or tensely: a violent rush enters the 'middle,' but the middle is also the lexical place of balance or excellence. The focus ayah becomes the start of a movement whose moral status is not settled by its energy; entry into the center can be tactical penetration or a contested claim to central/right position.

structural_cues: 100:5 introduces و س ط, whose inventory holds both spatial center and just/choice middle.
The focus root ع د و holds both running and morally negative overstepping, creating tension with the just-middle branch.
غ ي ر/B003 can mean changing a state or displacing wrong with right, allowing the incursion to be read as either violation or corrective transformation.
This model is new because no earlier ayah supplied a lexical middle capable of bearing moral ambiguity.

abductive_moves.assumption: The moral branch of و س ط can color the central entry, not merely sit dormant beside the spatial sense.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies the branch inventory, but the text's surface action is spatial entry into a gathering.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: supplied elements: transgressive running and central entry with a just-middle branch; inferred arrow: reaching the middle raises the question of whether the rush is wrongful overstepping or forceful restoration of a center.
alternatives: و س ط/B001 may be irrelevant here because the surface verb is spatial.
The raid model may remain purely martial without moral counter-reading.

changed_reading.before: Before 100:5, the focus could be morally edged as incursion, but no later branch challenged or complicated that moral direction.
changed_reading.after: After 100:5, the focus can initiate a morally ambiguous drive toward the middle: either overstepping into a crowd or forceful arrival at a central, possibly rightful position.

models.ablation: Removing 100:5 و س ط/B001 collapses this new reading into the ordinary raid-penetration model. Removing ع د و/B001 removes the moral tension between overstepping and just middle.

surprise_reading: With 100:5 revealed, the panting racers are no longer just a force that raises dust; they are a force that reaches the middle of a gathered body. One reading strongly becomes tactical penetration of an assembled enemy. Another revises exertion into concentrated momentum. A third makes the dust-cloud a medium of entry. A new exploratory reading notices the moral ambiguity of the middle itself: the rush may be overstepping, or a violent movement toward a claimed center of order.
